corrections.reason: The Ge'ez noun for 'corruption' is 'ሙስና' (2nd order 'ሙ'), and the short right-hand vowel stroke on 'ሙ' is clearly visible in the scan and confirmed by the immediate Amharic gloss 'ሙስና ፡ መቃብር' on line 10.
The printed glyph clearly has the 2nd-order stroke of 'ሙ' in 'ሙስና' ('ይርአይ ፡ ሙስና', Psalm 15:10 / Acts 13:35), matching line 28 below.
Both the visual scan (showing the right-side 'ሙ' tick) and canonical Ge'ez scripture (Acts 13:35 / Ps 15:10) confirm 'ሙስና', which is immediately echoed on line 26 ('ሙስና ፡ መቃብርም').
